svg.title: Three Robertsonian translocation orientations
svg.desc: Each metaphase-I spindle shows one replicated chromosome 14, one replicated chromosome 21, and one replicated rob(14;21). Adjacent-1 sends rob with 21, adjacent-2 sends rob with 14, and alternate sends rob to one pole and both normal acrocentrics to the other. The model uses the rearranged chromosome 14 centromere as the single active site. The short-arm product is usually lost before this stage.
